device_name: Cascadia AL 3D Printed Titanium Anterior Lumbar Spacer
description: The Cascadia AL Anterior Lumbar interbody spacer is a 3D printed titanium spacer for use in the ALIF procedure. The porous nature of the 3D printed lattice is designed for improved bony ingrowth and faster rate of fusion.
features: 3-5 micrometer surface roughness for bony on-growth
